visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Duplicates in the Result
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The common values of [1,2,2,3,4] and [2,4,4,6] should be [2,4], but the program prints [2,2,4].

solution.explanation: The second 2 in the first array is also found in the second array, so it is kept again. Checking that this is the first occurrence (a.indexOf(x) === i) keeps each common value only once.
